coverage_note: Selected functionality from Community Feedback 6–9 and Patches 1.6–1.7, reviewed through November 10. Added coverage of earlier audio changes and five previously omitted feature discussions. Patch 1.7 remains the latest verified release; November 6 statements describe further work and targets, not a new patch. This is not a complete roadmap or independent gameplay verification.
